units.source_text: 过了若干时日，小皇子回宫了。

en.t: After some days had passed, the young prince returned to the palace.

units.source_text: 这孩子长得越发秀美，竟不像是尘世间的人，因此父皇十分钟爱。

en.t: The child grew ever more graceful and beautiful, seeming almost not of this world, and so his imperial father loved him dearly.

units.source_text: 次年春天，该是立太子的时候了。

en.t: The following spring, the time came to appoint the crown prince.

units.source_text: 皇上心中颇思立这小皇子为太子。

en.t: In his heart, the emperor very much wished to make this young prince the crown prince.

units.source_text: 然而这小皇子没有高贵的外戚作后援；而废长立幼，又是世人所不能赞许之事，深恐反而不利于小皇子。

en.t: However, the young prince had no powerful noble relatives on his mother's side to support him; moreover, setting aside the elder son to raise up the younger was something the world could not approve, and the emperor feared it would instead harm the young prince.

units.source_text: 因此终于打消了这念头，不露声色，竟立了大皇子为太子。

en.t: Therefore he finally gave up the idea, showed nothing outwardly, and instead appointed the elder prince as crown prince.

units.source_text: 于是世人都说：“如此钟爱的小皇子，终于不立为太子，

en.t: Then everyone said, "Even this young prince, so dearly beloved, was not made crown prince after all,

units.source_text: 世事毕竟是有分寸的啊！”

en.t: so in the end, worldly affairs do have their proper bounds!"

units.source_text: 大皇子的母亲弘徽殿女御也放了心。

en.t: The Kokiden consort, mother of the elder prince, was also relieved.
